families.description: Instrument and mechanism diagnosis from conflicting observations

prompts.answer_rationale: A drifting local readout against a stable independent gauge and verified cable isolates the sensor.
A bend-sensitive intermittent readout points to wiring rather than the mechanism.
A flow path released by tapping the control body indicates a sticking valve.
Speed-linked grinding under a fixed drive and load identifies the bearing.
Fluid at a closed joint with falling pressure indicates a failed seal.
A powered unloaded rotor that still will not turn identifies the motor.
No-load heating and excess current with a free drivetrain identifies the motor.

answer_evidence.text: The fault follows a movable lead and vanishes when that lead is secured, while both endpoints test normally.

prompts.answer_rationale: A fault that follows and responds to securing a movable lead identifies the cable.

answer_evidence.text: Verified voltage reaches the liquid mover's terminals and its reservoir is full, yet the unit produces no vibration, sound, or discharge.

prompts.answer_rationale: A powered liquid mover with a full reservoir but no vibration or discharge identifies the pump.

answer_evidence.text: The contact never changes continuity in either position even though its actuator travels fully.

prompts.answer_rationale: A fully traveling actuator whose contact never changes continuity identifies the switch.

families.description: Fresh count, ratio, schedule, and remainder reasoning

prompts.answer_rationale: Five plus three equals eight.
Twelve minus three equals nine.
Five times two equals ten.
Three times four equals twelve.
Ten plus five equals fifteen.
Twenty minus four equals sixteen.
Nine times two equals eighteen.

answer_evidence.text: Five rows hold four units apiece.

prompts.answer_rationale: Five times four equals twenty.

answer_evidence.text: Six groups contain five units apiece.

prompts.answer_rationale: Six times five equals thirty.

answer_evidence.text: Eighty units are divided equally between two carriers.

prompts.answer_rationale: Eighty divided by two equals forty.

families.description: Mechanism-centered explanations in distinct technical domains

prompts.answer_rationale: Returning measured output to correct the next input is feedback.
Redundant reconstruction symbols implement parity protection.
Temporary capacity that absorbs and later releases a spike is a buffer.
A content-derived digest used as an address is hashing.
Dense measurement far above the retained bandwidth is an oversampling strategy within sampling.
Separating bands with low-pass and high-pass stages is filtering.
Solving symbolic equality constraints by substitution is unification.

answer_evidence.text: A new snapshot copies only nodes on one update path and reuses every untouched branch.

prompts.answer_rationale: Reusing untouched structure across snapshots is structural sharing.

answer_evidence.text: A measured frequency difference drives a cavity correction until evenly spaced lines remain locked.

prompts.answer_rationale: Using the measured beat error to correct the cavity is feedback.

answer_evidence.text: The desired harmonic is isolated while excitation leakage and unrelated bands are suppressed.

prompts.answer_rationale: Selecting one harmonic while suppressing other bands is filtering.

families.description: Ordered field, laboratory, and conservation procedures

prompts.answer_rationale: Because identity remains securely paired to each specimen, attaching its permanent catalog label is the uniquely safe next step.
Visible residue requires rinsing before a new sample is collected.
A new crack is a stop condition, so testing must cease.
An unverified environmental value must be measured before incubation.
An energized wet connector must be isolated before inspection.
Exceeding the launch wind limit requires stopping the launch.
New pigment loss requires stopping the sampling procedure.

answer_evidence.text: A culture plate shows an unplanned colony before transfer into the clean batch.

prompts.answer_rationale: A contaminated culture plate must be discarded rather than transferred.

answer_evidence.text: The receiver flange remains above its permitted temperature after the first cooldown stage.

prompts.answer_rationale: The next cooldown step must wait until the flange reaches its permitted temperature.

answer_evidence.text: The amber mount still carries uncured immersion fluid before polarized imaging.

prompts.answer_rationale: Imaging must wait until the mount is stable and the fluid has cured.

families.description: Exclusive support/refutation states: entailed=supported only, contradicted=refuted only, both=supported and refuted, neither=neither supported nor refuted

prompts.answer_rationale: Universal application to a stated member entails the claim.
The prohibition and membership contradict the claim.
The existential statement neither supports nor refutes the claim about parcel K.
Having a mentor only permits the act; it neither supports nor refutes the claim that Nia actually uses the lathe.
The universal route rule entails the claim for route L.
The explicit exclusion contradicts the placement claim.
The stated requirement applies directly to requested box R.

answer_evidence.text: Robots without a zone credential are barred from entering cell C, and robot J lacks that credential; the claim says J enters C.

prompts.answer_rationale: The missing credential triggers the explicit prohibition, contradicting the claim.

answer_evidence.text: Some genus T specimens have serrated leaves; specimen V is serrated; no rule supports or refutes membership of V in T; the claim assigns V to genus T.

prompts.answer_rationale: The explicit rule closure says the facts neither support nor refute V's membership in genus T.

answer_evidence.text: One queue rule assigns instrument P to the third slot while a valid cancellation rule bars P from that slot; the claim places P third.

prompts.answer_rationale: The assignment supports the claim and the cancellation rule refutes it, so the evidence state is both.

families.description: Intervention and control evidence for causal conclusions

prompts.answer_rationale: Random assignment followed by a treatment-specific change supports a causal interpretation.
A pre-existing chloride difference can explain the outcome, so the association is confounded.
Loss of the outcome difference after controlling the intermediate supports mediation.
A precise randomized comparison with no difference supports a null effect.
Treatment choice coupled to another change creates selection bias.
Randomized branch-level exclusion with a treatment-specific change supports causality.
A treatment-specific reverberation change in a randomized controlled crossover isolates a causal baffle effect.

answer_evidence.text: Wetland plots were paired on vegetation but upstream water supply still differed with both treatment and outcome.

prompts.answer_rationale: An uncontrolled water-supply difference remains a confounder despite vegetation matching.

answer_evidence.text: A daylight film reduced ultraviolet exposure, and the fading difference vanished after ultraviolet dose was included.

prompts.answer_rationale: The effect disappearing after accounting for ultraviolet dose supports mediation by that dose.

answer_evidence.text: Random tutoring schedules yielded no vocabulary difference and the confidence interval excluded the planned minimum gain.

prompts.answer_rationale: A randomized, precise no-difference result supports the null interpretation.
